description: Every PubMed E-utility, plus clinical-query refinement, a local article store, and trend/what's-new analytics no other PubMed tool ships.

tools.name: efetch_get
tools.description: Fetch full records for PMIDs (efetch returns XML or MEDLINE text, not JSON). Required: id. Optional: db (default: pubmed), rettype (default: abstract), retmode (default: text).

params.name: rettype
params.description: Record type: abstract | medline | xml | uilist

tools.name: einfo_get
tools.description: List Entrez databases, or describe fields/links for one db. Optional: db, retmode (default: json).

params.name: db
params.description: Database to describe (omit to list all databases)

tools.name: elink_get
tools.description: Find related articles or links for PMIDs. Required: id. Optional: dbfrom (default: pubmed), db (default: pubmed), cmd (plus 2 more).

params.name: cmd
params.description: Link command: neighbor | neighbor_score | prlinks | llinks

params.name: linkname
params.description: Specific link set, e.g. pubmed_pubmed (related) or pubmed_pmc

tools.name: esearch_run
tools.description: Run a raw PubMed query and return PMIDs + count. Required: term. Optional: db (default: pubmed), retmax (default: 20), retstart (default: 0) (plus 6 more).

params.name: term
params.description: PubMed query, e.g. 'atrial fibrillation AND anticoagulation'

params.name: retstart
params.description: Offset into the result set for paging

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: relevance | pub_date | Author | JournalName

params.name: datetype
params.description: Date field to filter on: pdat (publication) | edat (entrez) | mdat (modified)

params.name: reldate
params.description: Restrict to items added within the last N days

tools.name: esummary_get
tools.description: Get document summaries for one or more PMIDs. Required: id. Optional: db (default: pubmed), retmode (default: json).
